hypothesis.statement: Among held-out experimental TOTAL_SELECTION_EFFECT programmes, programmes prospectively classified as MULTI_COMPONENT_OR_CONSUMER_TURNOVER will have a larger equal-programme-weighted fraction of eligible repeated trait axes with bidirectionally uncertainty-supported reversal than programmes classified as SINGLE_REGISTERED_MODIFIER.

MULTI_COMPONENT_OR_CONSUMER_TURNOVER.rule: Before selection-sign inspection, the experiment independently varies at least two registered biotic dimensions or manipulates consumer identity/composition/assemblage while retaining a comparable plant-fitness total-selection estimand.

SINGLE_REGISTERED_MODIFIER.rule: Before selection-sign inspection, one registered biotic modifier is experimentally manipulated while consumer identity/composition is conceptually fixed and the focal total-selection estimand remains comparable.

EXTERNAL_SPATIAL_REPLICATION.rule: Population, landscape or geographic context varies observationally. These programmes may externally replicate the ecological pattern but are excluded from the primary experimental comparison.

UNRESOLVED_CONTEXT_DIMENSIONALITY.rule: The source design cannot be assigned to a primary class without interpretation that could depend on the observed selection outcome.

axis_event.definition: At least one source-defined context has supported positive total selection and at least one has supported negative total selection on the same eligible canonical trait axis.
supported_direction_sources: reported p<0.05 paired with coefficient sign

admission_rules: primary_source_id belongs to the frozen 463-record holdout queue
programme first qualifies after the V2 baseline commit
programme is independent of all eight development programmes
same-axis and TOTAL_SELECTION_EFFECT qualification rules remain unchanged
predictor class is frozen before selection-sign adjudication
at least one canonical trait axis has two or more source-defined comparable total-selection contexts
